# Read to Think

> A reading companion that refuses to summarize. Two modes — a structured "Deep Read"
> workflow and an AI "Socratic Companion" chat — both designed to make reading change
> your thinking, not transfer information.

## Philosophy
- Mortimer Adler (How to Read a Book): the highest reading asks "what does this book do to what I already believe?"
- Niklas Luhmann (Zettelkasten): one idea per note, in your own words; writing is the thinking.
- Rozenblit & Keil (Yale): re-reading creates recognition, not understanding (the illusion of fluency).

## Modes
- Deep Read: paste text -> extract claims -> think-first -> reveal author -> take a stance -> write an atomic note.
- AI Companion: a Socratic chat that never summarizes and probes your understanding.

## Privacy
- Bring your own API key (OpenAI or Groq). The key stays in your browser and is sent
  directly to the provider you choose. It never touches our server.
